message: Initial final audit assumed git --no-index --check returns0 for an untracked new-file diff. It returns1 even without whitespace diagnostics. A direct check confirmed this; final audit uses expected1 and requires empty stdout/stderr, with per-command core.autocrlf=false to avoid unrelated EOL advice. No persistent Git config or file bytes changed.
originalStderr: warning: LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it
